about.body: The S65 is BMW M's 4.0-litre V8 engine, produced from 2007 to 2013. It was fitted exclusively to the E9X generation M3 — the first and only M3 to use a V8 engine. The S65 is a high-revving naturally aspirated engine, closely related to the S85 V10 used in the E60 M5, sharing its bore spacing and many design principles. This is a performance-oriented engine with a character fundamentally different from the turbocharged engines that followed.

byModel.body: The S65 appears only in the M3 (E90/E91/E92/E93) generation, spanning the saloon, Touring, coupe, and convertible body styles. All E9X M3s use the same S65 engine regardless of body style, making it a straightforward application to identify — if you have an E9X M3, you have an S65.

compatibility.body: Because the S65 was fitted exclusively to the E9X M3 generation, compatibility is simpler than with engines spanning multiple model lines. However, there are still application-specific differences — the S65 in a saloon (E90) uses different ancillaries and mounting from the coupe (E92) or convertible (E93), and manual-transmission cars have different flywheel and clutch configurations than DCT-equipped cars.
